'''Essa'Mu''', which was thought to mean '''Dragbelly''',  was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[tineback]] that lived on [[Ruhnuk]] before the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. This creature belonged to the "beefy" variety of tineback that designated tinebacks smaller and more friendly than other strains. Essa'Mu was adopted by [[Miner/Legends|miners]]<ref name="TOR:Tineback" /> of the [[Gatressa Mining Conglomerate]]<ref name="TOR:CoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Catastrophe on Ruhnuk}}</ref> who named the creature after its stubbier-than-normal legs.<ref name="TOR:Tineback" />
